from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
import os, re, pathlib

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/145-13/1_145-13_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/145-13_0_00784fea/1_145-13_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Locate the relevant columns by header text so the code is robust to same-layout hidden data.
header_row = 1
headers = {}
for cell in ws[header_row]:
    if cell.value is not None:
        headers[str(cell.value).strip().upper()] = cell.column

dates_col = headers.get("DATES")
days_col = headers.get("NO OF DAYS")
if dates_col is None or days_col is None:
    raise ValueError(f"Required headers not found. Headers: {headers}")

def count_leave_days(date_value):
    """Count date/day entries listed in the DATES column."""
    if date_value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(date_value, (int, float)) and not isinstance(date_value, bool):
        # A single numeric date/day entry.
        return 1 if str(date_value).strip() != "" else None
    text = str(date_value).strip()
    if text == "":
        return None
    # Dates are listed comma-separated; count non-empty parts.
    parts = [p.strip() for p in text.split(",") if p.strip() != ""]
    return len(parts)

# For the requested range H2:H6, fill only those cells.
for row in range(2, 7):
    ws.cell(row=row, column=days_col).value = count_leave_days(ws.cell(row=row, column=dates_col).value)

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: read back the answer_position cells.
wb2 = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
ws2 = wb2["Sheet1"]
print("Answer cells H2:H6:")
for row in range(2, 7):
    cell = ws2.cell(row=row, column=8)
    print(cell.coordinate, cell.value, type(cell.value).__name__)
